decisions.rationale: The legacy clause has no justified OWL structural mapping; inventing a property-chain axiom would misrepresent the original parser contract.
The public grammar returns ClassAssertion, ObjectPropertyAssertion, SameIndividual and DifferentIndividuals axioms, but the Java whole-document production fails to add them to the ontology.
OWLAPI's NAME token shadows INT, making all three published cardinality productions unreachable. JavaScript retains the declared at-least, at-most and exactly grammar with required fillers.
Document-relative resolution produces valid stable IRIs; the Java Optional[...] prefix is an implementation artifact, not KRSS syntax.
OWL 2 structural ObjectIntersectionOf and ObjectUnionOf require at least two operands; the Java implementation exposes a singleton object outside that invariant.
Although the lexer declares an IRI token, original-KRSS entity productions accept only alphanumeric Name tokens.
